title: Crate
description: A wooden crate of worn Beatles LPs, from Please Please Me to Abbey Road, seen from just above. Drag or scroll to flip the real sleeves forward one after another, and pull one up out of the crate to slide its record half out.
intent: One record-shop gesture finished to the edge: real cardboard sleeves with weight, ring wear and gloss that tip under your hand, and a black record with its own groove sheen that slides out when you lift one.
